chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to me, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Muqri, from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak, from Abdullah ibn Jabla, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them), who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Whoever lives to be forty years old is protected from the three types of madness, leprosy, and vitiligo; and whoever lives to be fifty years old, God grants him repentance (returning to Him); and whoever lives to be sixty years old, God lightens his reckoning on the Day of Resurrection; and whoever lives to be seventy years old, his good deeds are recorded and his bad deeds are not recorded; and whoever lives to be eighty years old, his past and future sins are forgiven for him, and he walks on the earth forgiven, and intercession is granted for his family.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards for reaching the ages of forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, and eighty in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (via the Prophet) outlines a progressive spiritual elevation linked to longevity, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the accumulation of *hasanat* and the easing of divine reckoning (*hisab*) through sustained worship. It highlights the transition from physical protection at forty to complete forgiveness and familial intercession (*shafa'ah*) by eighty, underscoring the value of a long, pious life in Shia eschatology.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 22-21 Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hassan al-Saffar quoted Ibrahim ibn Hashim, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ali al-Muqar’ri, on the authority of Yahya ibn al-Mobarak, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Jabal’le, on the authority of Ishaq ibn Ammar, on the authority of Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB), on the authority of his father (MGB), on the authority of his forefathers (MGB), on the authority of Ali (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) said,

“God will protect anyone who attains the age of forty from insanity, vitiligo and leprosy. God will ease the Reckoning of anyone who reaches the age of fifty. God will grant anyone who reaches the age of sixty opportunity to repent. God and the companions of the heavens love anyone who reaches the age of seventy. God will order the good deeds to be recorded, and the bad deeds to be eliminated for anyone who reaches the age of eighty. Whenever a man reaches the age of ninety, God will forgive all his past and future sins. He will be considered to be one of the slaves of God on Earth.”
